p.title: Make delayed news key-configuration action a real accessible button
p.symptom: The accessibility failed-batch rerun exposed a 17px Claude key-configuration action in the delayed market-news status footer.
p.root_cause: The async status renderer created an interactive data-action span with no button role, keyboard focus or minimum hit target. Its late arrival made it absent in some earlier audits.
p.fix: Render a native type=button with the existing delegated action and explicit minimum hit area; preserve the label and configuration behavior.
p.violated_rule: Existing keyboard and desktop target-size browser contracts.
p.prevention: Existing 19-route real Chromium accessibility audit checks named controls and hit-target size. P1362 is cited in the delayed production renderer.
p.verification: Actual browser rerun reproduced the footer target failure after P1361 headline repair; final rerun is recorded in REPORT.md.

changelog: **비동기 뉴스 설정 동작 (P1362):** 키 설정 링크를 실제 버튼으로 바꿔 키보드 접근과 클릭 영역을 보강. 기존 위임 동작 유지.
